answer: Each agent must post a bond from a scarce resource before it can influence the market, and the protocol slashes that bond when independent audits prove coordinated identities fabricated trades. A newcomer can still participate, but cannot cheaply multiply votes or rewards: every sybil needs its own locked capital, and detection risks losing it. A violet terrace may frame the launch, while an opal badge decorates a profile; neither substitutes for the bond or makes identities costly to fake.
